questions.question: Ranjan in his ODI Cricket career, scored 15 runs on an average in 10 matches. If he scored 14 runs on an average in the first 4 matches and 12 runs on an average in the last 4 matches, then find the average of the runs scored by him in the remaining 2 matches.
questions.solution:
• Average runs in total 10 matches = 15

∴ sum of runs in total 10 matches = 15 × 10 = 150. 

 
• Average runs in first 4 matches = 14

∴ sum of runs in first 4 matches = 14 × 4 = 56. 

 
• Average runs in last 4 matches = 12

∴ sum of runs in last 4 matches = 12 × 4 = 48. 

 
• Sum of runs in the remaining 2 matches = total runs in 10 matches - (sum of runs in first 4 matches + sum of runs in last 4 matches)

∴ sum of runs in remaining 2 matches = 150 - (56 + 48) = 150 - 104 = 46.​

⇒ average of runs in remaining 2 matches = 46 ÷ 2 = 23

Hence, the correct answer is "23".

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

64 + 36 ÷ 3 × 9 - 32 = 44
questions.solution:
__**BODMAS RULE**:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337cba09b098a129c60c88ca431dc00f7470bb1b39c1452e8d81688a7d6b6b0e.png] 

Option 1) : 64 and 36

Given equation: 64 + 36 ÷ 3 × 9 - 32 = 44

By interchanging 64 and 36 in the given equation.

Interchanged equation is :36 + **__64 ÷ 3__** × 9 - 32 = 44

⇒ 36 + __**21.333 × 9**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**36 + 191.997**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**227.997**____** - 32**__ = 44

⇒ 195.997 ≠ 44

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 9 and 64

Given equation : 64 + 36 ÷ 3 × 9 - 32 = 44

By interchanging 9 and 64 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is: 9 + __**36 ÷ 3**__ × 64 - 32 = 44

⇒ 9 + __**12 × 64**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**9**____** + 768**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**777**____** - 32**__ = 44

⇒ 745 ≠ 44

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 3 and 9

Given equation : 64 + 36 ÷ 3 × 9 - 32 = 44

By interchanging 3 and 9 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is: 64 + __**36 ÷ 9**__ × 3 - 32 = 44

⇒ 64 + __**4 × 3**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**64 + 12**__ - 32 = 44

⇒ __**76**____** - 32**__ = 44

**⇒ 44 = 44**

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : 32 and 36

Given equation : 64 + 36 ÷ 3 × 9 - 32 = 44

By interchanging 32 and 36 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is: 64 + __**32 ÷ 3**__ × 9 - 36 = 44

⇒ 64 + __**10.66 × 9**__ - 36 = 44

⇒ __**64 + 95.94**__ - 36 = 44

⇒ __**159.94**____** - 36**__ = 44

⇒ 123.94 ≠ 44

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Thus, the correct answer is **"3 and 9".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, GATHER is coded as 107 and HONOUR is coded as 74. How will HEAVEN be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5016d46753aa9a1cfc227e78c4a1817ad4590ab58540c1e37fc2b8fb70a1cdd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• ***Code = sum of positional values of opposite letters in the word + no. of consonants in the word***
 
• GATHER is coded as 107:
 
 
• No. of consonants in GATHER = 4 (G, T, H, R)
 
• G + A + T + H + E + R ⇔ (T + Z + G + S + V + I) + 4 = (20 + 26 + 7 + 19 + 22 + 9) + 4 = 103 + 4 = **107**
 
 
 
• HONOUR is coded as 74
 
 
• No. of consonants in HONOUR = 3 (H, N, R)
 
• H + O + N + O + U + R ⇔ (S + L + M + L + F + I) + 3 = (19 + 12 + 13 + 12 + 6 + 9) + 3 = 71 + 3 = 74
 
 
 
• ​Similarly, HEAVEN will be coded as 110.
 
 
• No. of consonants in HEAVEN = 3 (H, V, N)
 
• H + E + A + V + E + N ⇔ (S + V + Z + E + V + M) + 3 = (19 + 22 + 26 + 5 + 22 + 13) + 3 = 107 + 3 = 110
 
 

Hence, 110 is the correct answer.

Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the numbers of the given set.

(277, 14, 9)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number = (second number)² + (third number)²**

 
• (277, 14, 9) → 14² + 9² → 196 + 81 = 277

Similarly,

 
• (313, 12, 13) → 12² + 13² → 144 + 169 = **313**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(313, 12, 13)".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All roads are cycles.

No cycle is a car.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cycles are roads.

II. No road is a car.

III. No car is a cycle.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for given statements is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c9485b43a920c64322b047a27586b951ace019b2cb94e7ac466b0dd7aff4b84.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cycles are roads → Follows (As shown in the Venn diagram, a part of the cycle is road)

II. No road is a car → Follows (As shown in the Venn diagram, no road is a car because all roads are cycles and no cycle is a car.)

III. No car is a cycle → Follows (Because no cycle is a car, no car is a cycle.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"All the conclusions follow".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

364 : 183 :: 462 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number = (Second number × 2) - 2**

 
• 364 : 183 → (183 × 2) - 2 = 366 - 2 = 364

Similarly,

 
• 462 :** 232** → (232 × 2) - 2 = 464 - 2 = 462

Thus, the correct answer is **"232".**

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 12
 15
 11
 
 

 14
 5
 17
 
 

 16
 ?
 19
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**In a column:**

**(1st number + 2nd number) - (1st number - 2) = 3rd number.**

Column 1: (12 + 14) - (12 - 2) = 26 - 10 = 16

Column 3: (11 + 17) - (11 - 2) = 28 - 9 = 19

Similarly, 

Column 2: (15 + 5) - (15 - 2) = 20 - 13 = 7

Hence, **7** is the correct answer.
